span.p:
Philosophy: no prefill phase / decode phase.
Every request has num_computed_tokens
chasing num_tokens_with_spec.
Chunked prefill, prefix caching, and spec decode
are all just the same loop.

span.p:
num_new_tokens = num_tokens_with_spec
+ placeholders − num_computed_tokens
capped by token budget, long_prefill_token_threshold,
max_model_len

span.p:
Preempt: victim = running[-1] (FCFS)
or max(priority, arrival_time)
_preempt_request(): free blocks,
num_computed_tokens=0, back to waiting
